description.zh: 带排版与主题样式的文本标签
description.en: Text labels with cached layout and theme styles

exercise.zh: 修改示例代码中的标题和字号，重新运行比较排版
exercise.en: Edit the title and font size in the example, then rerun to compare the layout

notes.zh: 标签用于显示内容，不代替输入框。文字或字号改变后重新测量，避免裁剪与错误换行。
notes.en: Labels display content rather than edit it. Remeasure after text or font changes to avoid clipping and incorrect wrapping.

description.zh: 触发一项明确的操作
description.en: Trigger a clearly named action

exercise.zh: 点击按钮，或按 Tab 聚焦后按 Enter，观察计数变化
exercise.en: Click the button, or focus it with Tab and press Enter, to increment the count

notes.zh: 操作使用明确的动词命名。通过 ACTION_ACTIVATE 处理激活；禁用时不应执行操作，图标与文字均受样式控制。
notes.en: Name the action with a clear verb and handle ACTION_ACTIVATE. Disabled buttons must not perform the action; styling controls icons and text.

description.zh: 用图标承载紧凑操作
description.en: Compact actions represented by an icon

exercise.zh: 切换收藏，保留可理解的文字名称
exercise.en: Toggle a favorite with an accessible action name

notes.zh: 图标按钮仍需可理解的操作名称，必要时配合 Tooltip。图标大小与点击区域分开设置。
notes.en: Provide a meaningful action name even when only an icon is visible. A Tooltip can add context. Set icon size independently from the hit area.

description.zh: 编辑单行文本
description.en: Edit a single line of text

exercise.zh: 输入项目名并清空
exercise.en: Enter and clear a project name

notes.zh: 适用于单行数据。通过应用状态读取文本并处理变更；多行内容使用 TextArea，带标签与校验提示时使用 Field。
notes.en: Use for single-line values. Read and update text through application state; choose TextArea for multiple lines or Field for a label and validation feedback.

description.zh: 编辑多行文本
description.en: Edit multiple lines of text

exercise.zh: 编写一段说明，尝试换行
exercise.en: Write a description with line breaks

notes.zh: 适用于长文本与换行。为内容保留足够高度，并区分内部滚动与外层页面滚动。
notes.en: Use for longer text and line breaks. Reserve enough height and distinguish editor scrolling from the outer page scroll.

description.zh: 将标签、帮助与校验结合到输入框
description.en: Combine a label, help and validation with an input

exercise.zh: 留空后提交，再填写名称
exercise.en: Submit an empty name, then correct it

notes.zh: 标签、帮助与错误信息不应互相替代。应用负责校验值，再设置错误状态；红色边框本身不会验证数据。
notes.en: Labels, help and errors serve different purposes. Validate in the application before setting the error state; a red border does not validate data.

description.zh: 为多行文本提供标签与校验
description.en: Label and validate longer text

exercise.zh: 填写说明并观察字数
exercise.en: Write a description and watch the character count

notes.zh: 通过 text_field_area 创建带装饰的多行字段。设置合理行数与字数提示，错误信息需指出如何修正。
notes.en: Use text_field_area for a decorated multiline field. Choose useful row and counter settings, and make errors explain how to correct the value.

description.zh: 浏览可展开的层级节点
description.en: Browse expandable hierarchical nodes

exercise.zh: 展开目录并选择文件
exercise.en: Expand a folder and select a file

notes.zh: 树用于表达父子层级。展开状态与当前选择分开管理，过滤后仍需保留节点身份，叶节点动作由应用处理。
notes.en: Trees express parent-child relationships. Manage expansion separately from selection, retain node identity when filtering, and handle leaf actions in the application.

description.zh: 用按钮呈现任务执行状态
description.en: Show task progress inside an action button

exercise.zh: 开始任务，等待完成后重试
exercise.en: Start a task, wait for completion and run again

notes.zh: 任务按钮需要区分未开始、执行中、成功与失败。实际任务由应用执行，控件的进度显示不会启动后台工作。
notes.en: Distinguish idle, running, success and failure. The application performs the task; displaying progress does not start background work.

description.zh: 独立切换一个选项
description.en: Toggle an independent option

exercise.zh: 勾选复选框，查看布尔值的变化
exercise.en: Toggle the checkbox and observe the boolean value

notes.zh: 用于独立布尔选项，可提供混合状态。值变化与操作激活不同；一组互斥选择使用 RadioGroup。
notes.en: Use for independent boolean options, optionally with an indeterminate state. A value change differs from action activation; use RadioGroup for exclusive choices.

description.zh: 即时开启或关闭一项设置
description.en: Turn a setting on or off immediately

exercise.zh: 切换开关，查看布尔值的变化
exercise.en: Toggle the switch and observe the boolean value

notes.zh: 用于即时生效的开关设置。标签应描述被切换的设置，开启与关闭状态都要易于理解。
notes.en: Use for settings that take effect immediately. Label the setting rather than the action and make both on and off states understandable.

description.zh: 在互斥选项中选择一个
description.en: Choose one mutually exclusive option

exercise.zh: 激活单选控件，查看选中状态
exercise.en: Activate the radio control and observe its selected state

notes.zh: 一个 Radio 表示互斥选择中的一项。由应用或 RadioGroup 维护同组其他项，避免多个选项同时选中。
notes.en: A Radio represents one item in an exclusive choice. Coordinate its peers through the application or RadioGroup so multiple items cannot stay selected.

description.zh: 统一管理一组单选项
description.en: Manage a related group of choices

exercise.zh: 切换选项并查看当前选择
exercise.en: Switch options and observe the current choice

notes.zh: 选项属于同一个问题。选择值和显示标签分开管理，默认项应在创建时确定。
notes.en: Keep options focused on one question. Separate the selected value from its displayed label and choose the initial selection at creation.

description.zh: 在连续区间内调节数值
description.en: Adjust a value within a range

exercise.zh: 拖动滑块，或聚焦后按方向键，查看当前数值
exercise.en: Drag the slider, or use arrow keys after focusing it, to change the value

notes.zh: 创建时提供最小值、最大值与当前值。按业务设置步长，并说明拖动时更新还是完成后提交。
notes.en: Provide minimum, maximum and current values. Choose a useful step and decide whether changes apply during dragging or only on commit.

description.zh: 按固定步长增减数值
description.en: Increase or decrease a value by a fixed step

exercise.zh: 调整数量，试试上下限
exercise.en: Adjust a quantity and try its limits

notes.zh: 适合小范围、离散数量。设置最小值、最大值与步长，并为到达边界时的状态提供明确反馈。
notes.en: Use for small, discrete quantities. Set minimum, maximum and step values and make the limit state clear.

description.zh: 从给定选项中选择一个
description.en: Pick one option from a fixed set

exercise.zh: 点击展开选项，或聚焦后用方向键更换选择
exercise.en: Open the options, or use arrow keys after focusing the control, to change the selection

notes.zh: 选项来自固定集合。需要分组或禁用项时使用带选项元数据的创建方法，不能把组标题当作可选值。
notes.en: Options come from a fixed set. Use option metadata for groups and disabled items; group headings are not selectable values.

description.zh: 结合输入与候选项选择
description.en: Combine typing with suggested choices

exercise.zh: 输入文字筛选候选项
exercise.en: Type to filter the suggestions

notes.zh: 输入与候选选择相结合。明确是否允许不在列表中的自定义值，过滤只影响候选展示。
notes.en: Combine typing and selection. Decide explicitly whether custom values outside the list are accepted; filtering only changes the suggestions.

description.zh: 从列表中选择多项
description.en: Choose multiple items from a list

exercise.zh: 选择多个标签，再移除一个
exercise.en: Select several labels and remove one

notes.zh: 每项具有独立的选中状态。让用户看见已选项目，并提供容易撤销的移除操作。
notes.en: Each option has its own selected state. Keep chosen items visible and provide an easy way to remove them.

description.zh: 选择日历日期
description.en: Choose a calendar date

exercise.zh: 更改预约日期并查看结果
exercise.en: Change an appointment date

notes.zh: 日期值与显示格式分开处理。按地区设置日期格式、周起始日及可选范围，避免只依赖占位文字说明格式。
notes.en: Separate date values from their display format. Configure locale, week start and selectable ranges; do not rely only on placeholder text.

description.zh: 选择一天中的时刻
description.en: Choose a time of day

exercise.zh: 调节预约时间
exercise.en: Adjust an appointment time

notes.zh: 为业务选择 12 或 24 小时格式及是否显示秒。时间显示与实际业务时区由应用明确约定。
notes.en: Choose 12- or 24-hour formatting and whether seconds are shown. The application defines the relationship between displayed time and its business time zone.

description.zh: 选择并查看颜色值
description.en: Choose a color and inspect its value

exercise.zh: 更换颜色并查看色值
exercise.en: Choose a color and read its value

notes.zh: 同时提供色块与可读的颜色值。应用应检查输入格式与透明度含义，不能只通过颜色表达状态。
notes.en: Show a swatch together with a readable value. Validate input format and alpha semantics, and do not use color as the only state indicator.

description.zh: 在相关内容面板间切换
description.en: Switch between related content panels

exercise.zh: 切换 Overview、Activity、Settings，观察选中项编号
exercise.en: Switch between Overview, Activity and Settings and observe the selected index

notes.zh: 每个标签对应一个内容面板。选择切换时更新面板可见性，保留独立的键盘焦点行为。
notes.en: Each tab corresponds to a content panel. Update panel visibility on selection while retaining independent keyboard focus behavior.

description.zh: 在少量同级视图间快速切换
description.en: Switch quickly between a few peer views

exercise.zh: 切换分段，观察选中项编号
exercise.en: Switch segments and observe the selected index

notes.zh: 适合少量同级视图或模式。与 Tabs 共用选择逻辑，文案应简短，不要承载过长的选项列表。
notes.en: Use for a few peer views or modes. Selection shares Tabs behavior; keep labels brief and avoid long option lists.

description.zh: 在可滚动列表中选择条目
description.en: Select an item from a scrollable list

exercise.zh: 点击条目或聚焦后使用方向键，观察选择变化
exercise.en: Click a row or use arrow keys after focusing the list to change the selection

notes.zh: 列表选择与滚动是独立状态。让当前选中项可辨认，并在内容变化时校验选择下标。
notes.en: Selection and scrolling are separate states. Make the selected item recognizable and validate its index when the data changes.

description.zh: 按列展示并操作结构化记录
description.en: Browse structured records in columns

exercise.zh: 点击表头切换排序
exercise.en: Click a column header to change sorting

notes.zh: 列类型决定排序含义。数字列应按数值排序，列宽与最小宽度需要兼顾内容及可用空间。
notes.en: Column types determine sorting semantics. Sort numeric columns by value and balance column and minimum widths against available space.

description.zh: 在分页数据中移动
description.en: Move through paginated data

exercise.zh: 切换页码，观察当前页编号
exercise.en: Switch pages and observe the current page number

notes.zh: 页数、当前页和每页条数需要与实际数据同步。分页交互只提出页码变更，数据加载由应用完成。
notes.en: Keep page count, current page and page size synchronized with the data. Pagination requests a change; the application loads the data.

description.zh: 显示当前位置并返回上级
description.en: Show the current location and navigate to ancestors

exercise.zh: 点击路径段，查看触发的层级编号
exercise.en: Click a path segment and observe the activated index

notes.zh: 展示从根到当前位置的路径。祖先可以返回，当前页应明确区分，长路径需要合理折叠或裁剪。
notes.en: Show the path from the root to the current location. Distinguish the current page from navigable ancestors and handle long paths gracefully.

description.zh: 显示已完成的任务比例
description.en: Show how much of a task is complete

exercise.zh: 点击按钮逐步增加进度，查看百分比
exercise.en: Click the button to increase progress and observe the percentage

notes.zh: 原生进度值使用 0 到 1，百分比显示由应用转换。已知进度使用 Progress，未知持续时间使用 Spinner。
notes.en: Native progress values range from 0 to 1; the application converts them to percentages. Use Progress for known progress and Spinner for an unknown duration.

description.zh: 表示尚不能确定进度的等待
description.en: Indicate work with an unknown duration

exercise.zh: 开始或暂停加载动画
exercise.en: Start or pause the loading indicator

notes.zh: 只表达正在等待，不承诺完成比例。配合文字说明正在进行的工作，并在工作结束或取消后停止。
notes.en: Indicate waiting without promising a completion percentage. Add a description of the work and stop when it completes or is cancelled.

description.zh: 在内容之间建立视觉分隔
description.en: Separate adjacent sections visually

exercise.zh: 修改示例中的分隔方向，重新运行比较外观
exercise.en: Change the divider orientation in the source and rerun to compare its appearance

notes.zh: 分隔线只负责视觉分组，不是交互目标。方向由布局决定，避免给装饰性分隔添加无意义焦点。
notes.en: Dividers group content visually rather than act as controls. Choose the orientation for the layout and avoid unnecessary focus stops.

description.zh: 为内容补充数量或状态
description.en: Attach a count or status to content

exercise.zh: 点击按钮增加徽标数字
exercise.en: Click the button to increment the badge count

notes.zh: 数量、状态点与状态文字是不同用途。徽标应依附于它说明的内容，并保留文字或其他可访问的状态说明。
notes.en: Counts, dots and text badges have different roles. Attach the badge to the content it describes and retain an accessible explanation of the state.

description.zh: 将相关内容组织成一个区域
description.en: Group related content into one region

exercise.zh: 观察卡片容器，修改示例中的尺寸后重新运行
exercise.en: Inspect the card container, then edit its dimensions and rerun

notes.zh: 卡片组织相关内容，可分为标题、正文和操作区域。子控件需要正确设置父节点，间距随布局和主题保持一致。
notes.en: Cards group related content and can separate heading, body and actions. Set child parents correctly and keep spacing consistent with layout and theme.

description.zh: 让受限区域容纳更多内容
description.en: Fit longer content inside a bounded viewport

exercise.zh: 滚动列表，保持页面其余部分不动
exercise.en: Scroll the panel independently

notes.zh: 内容范围决定可滚动距离，视口决定裁剪范围。滚动内容中的子控件仍需使用正确的父节点与坐标。
notes.en: Content extent determines travel while the viewport determines clipping. Children inside scrolling content still need the correct parent and coordinates.

description.zh: 在锚点附近展示可操作内容
description.en: Show interactive content beside an anchor

exercise.zh: 打开偏好设置并应用选择
exercise.en: Open preferences and apply a choice

notes.zh: 依附于锚点展示短暂、可交互的内容。明确应用与取消的区别，关闭浮层不应自动提交尚未确认的编辑。
notes.en: Show temporary interactive content beside an anchor. Distinguish apply from cancel; dismissing the popover should not commit an unconfirmed edit.

description.zh: 为锚点补充简短说明
description.en: Add a short explanation to an anchor

exercise.zh: 悬停或聚焦帮助按钮
exercise.en: Hover or focus the help button

notes.zh: 补充说明而不承载必须执行的操作。鼠标悬停与键盘焦点都应能触达提示，重要信息不能只存在于提示中。
notes.en: Add context without requiring an action inside the tooltip. Support both hover and keyboard focus and keep essential information outside the tooltip too.

description.zh: 统一呈现短暂通知
description.en: Present transient notifications in one place

exercise.zh: 显示通知，再手动关闭
exercise.en: Show a notification and dismiss it

notes.zh: 短暂通知由统一宿主管理。重要错误不应只显示为自动消失的通知，撤销或关闭操作需要可访问。
notes.en: Manage transient notices in one host. Do not expose important errors only through disappearing notifications; keep undo and dismiss actions accessible.

description.zh: 在独立对话框中完成当前决策
description.en: Complete a focused decision in a dialog

exercise.zh: 打开确认框，分别取消与确认
exercise.en: Open a confirmation, cancel it and confirm it

notes.zh: 模态期间将交互限制在对话框，关闭后将焦点返回触发位置。确认、取消及关闭需要明确的业务含义。
notes.en: Keep interaction inside the dialog while open and restore focus to its trigger on close. Define confirm, cancel and dismiss behavior explicitly.

description.zh: 在原生界面中嵌入网页
description.en: Embed web content inside a native interface

exercise.zh: 切换独立预览页面
exercise.en: Switch between embedded preview pages

notes.zh: 原生 WebView 需要桌面宿主，具有独立的加载、焦点与关闭生命周期。演练场的浏览器预览不代表操作系统 WebView2 或其他原生宿主。
notes.en: Native WebView requires a desktop host and has its own loading, focus and disposal lifecycle. The browser preview is not an operating-system WebView2 or other native host.

description.zh: 将相关操作或选择组合成一组
description.en: Group related actions or selections

exercise.zh: 切换分组按钮，查看当前选项
exercise.en: Switch grouped buttons and observe the active option

notes.zh: 根据用途选择独立操作、单选或多选模式。选项使用稳定的 key，显示标签变化不应改变其业务身份。
notes.en: Choose action, single-select or multi-select mode. Use stable item keys so changing labels does not change business identity.

description.zh: 将一组数据转为图形
description.en: Visualize a series of data points

exercise.zh: 点击柱形选择数据，使用滚轮缩放图表
exercise.en: Select a bar and use the wheel to zoom the chart

notes.zh: 数据系列与图形类型分开管理。保留可读的数值说明，更新系列后重新呈现，避免只凭颜色区分系列。
notes.en: Manage data series independently from chart type. Retain readable values, present again after updates, and distinguish series by more than color.

description.zh: 用两个端点选择数值范围
description.en: Choose a range using two endpoints

exercise.zh: 调整最小值与最大值
exercise.en: Adjust the lower and upper bounds

notes.zh: 两个端点共同表示范围。处理最小值、最大值及端点交叉策略，并让每个端点都能通过键盘调整。
notes.en: Two endpoints define the range. Specify bounds and how crossings are handled and make both endpoints keyboard adjustable.

description.zh: 在可调分隔区域中安排内容
description.en: Arrange content in resizable panes

exercise.zh: 调节两个面板的占比
exercise.en: Resize the two panes

notes.zh: 分割比例决定两个面板的空间。子内容归属到相应面板；约束最小尺寸，避免调节后内容无法使用。
notes.en: The split ratio allocates space to two panes. Parent content to the correct pane and enforce minimum sizes so resizing cannot make it unusable.

description.zh: 以命令列表呈现操作
description.en: Present actions in a command list

exercise.zh: 打开菜单并选择命令
exercise.en: Open a menu and choose a command

notes.zh: 命令、分组、勾选项和子菜单有不同语义。菜单项使用稳定标识，激活后由应用执行命令。
notes.en: Commands, groups, checked items and submenus have different semantics. Use stable item identifiers and execute commands in the application after activation.

description.zh: 在操作对象附近显示相关命令
description.en: Show commands next to the affected object

exercise.zh: 在控件上右键，或聚焦后按 Enter 打开菜单并选择命令
exercise.en: Right-click the control, or focus it and press Enter, to open the menu and choose a command

notes.zh: 使用 Menu 的上下文模式，在目标附近打开相关命令。应提供键盘或按钮入口，不仅支持鼠标右键。
notes.en: Use Menu in context mode to show commands near the target. Provide a keyboard or button entry rather than relying only on right-click.

description.zh: 组合默认操作与备选命令
description.en: Combine a primary action with alternatives

exercise.zh: 使用默认动作，再展开备选项
exercise.en: Use the main action and choose an alternative

notes.zh: 使用 Menu 的分离按钮模式。默认命令与展开备选菜单是两个操作，需要分别命名和处理。
notes.en: Use Menu in split mode. The default command and the alternatives menu are separate actions and need separate names and handling.

description.zh: 在掩码显示下编辑密码
description.en: Edit a password with a masked display

exercise.zh: 输入示例文字，切换显隐
exercise.en: Enter sample text and toggle visibility

notes.zh: 掩码显示不等于内存加密。原生显隐切换保留值与选择，复制与剪切仍被禁止；应用不得把实际密码写入日志。
notes.en: Masking is not memory encryption. Native reveal preserves the value and selection while copy and cut remain blocked; applications must not log the real password.
